{{- /* Guide page body: drops the duplicate H1 that Hugo renders from the title, then turns inline code that names a public SDK symbol into a link to its API reference page. Why a post-render pass and not a render hook: Hugo has no render hook for inline code (only link/image/heading/codeblock/table/blockquote), and the most valuable mentions live in hand-authored Props tables — whose Type and "Inherited from" columns are plain code spans today. Only spans that are a type expression are rewritten: a name, an array of it, or a union of those (`IMeasure`, `IMeasure[]`, `IBucket | undefined`). A bare name keeps the whole chip as the link (`IInsight`). In an array or union the chip stays one piece and only the names inside it link (`IBucket | undefined`): splitting it into several chips would leave visible gaps between them, and linking the whole chip would send `undefined` to the IBucket page. The chip colour for those inner links comes from `.prose code > a` in main.css.tmpl. - lowercase names (`measures`, `onError`, `undefined`) collide with symbol names and must never link - fenced code blocks render as ``, so they cannot match - names that do not resolve (React types like `ComponentType`, internal symbols, or a missing data file) stay plain code - code already inside an anchor (generated Props tables emit real links) is never rewritten, so links cannot nest */ -}} {{- $content := replaceRE `]*>.*?\n?` "" .Content 1 -}} {{- $refs := (partialCached "api-data.html" . .Section).refs -}} {{- if $refs -}} {{- $content = replaceRE `(]*>)` "${1}" $content -}} {{- /* lowercase name -> permalink, or "" when it does not resolve */ -}} {{- $urls := dict -}} {{- range findRE `[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\[\])?( ?\| ?[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\[\])?)*` $content | uniq -}} {{- $span := . -}} {{- $expr := replaceRE `` "" $span -}} {{- $pieces := slice -}} {{- $linked := false -}} {{- range split $expr "|" -}} {{- $piece := . -}} {{- $member := trim $piece " " -}} {{- $name := strings.TrimSuffix "[]" $member -}} {{- $url := "" -}} {{- if findRE `^[A-Z]` $name -}} {{- $key := lower $name -}} {{- if isset $urls $key -}} {{- $url = index $urls $key -}} {{- else -}} {{- $url = partial "api-name-url.html" (dict "page" $ "name" $name) -}} {{- $urls = merge $urls (dict $key $url) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- with $url -}} {{- $linked = true -}} {{- $piece = replace $piece $name (printf `%s` . $name) -}} {{- end -}} {{- $pieces = $pieces | append $piece -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Inserted code is marked data-linked so a later, shorter span cannot match inside it. */ -}} {{- if $linked -}} {{- if findRE `^[A-Za-z0-9_]+$` $expr -}} {{- /* A bare name keeps the original shape: the whole chip is the link. */ -}} {{- $content = replace $content $span (printf `%s` (index $urls (lower $expr)) $expr) -}} {{- else -}} {{- $content = replace $content $span (printf "%s" (delimit $pieces "|")) -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $content = replace $content "" "" -}} {{- end -}} {{- /* Links to folded API members go straight to their section on the parent's page. */ -}} {{- return partial "api-member-links.html" $content -}}
